metadata.qualification: Same ten pinned token-ID prompts as AKAS, same target GGUF, F16 KV in target and draft, greedy sampling with penalties disabled. One warmup and two samples per prompt. Acceptance is llama.cpp draft_n_accepted/draft_n, retained separately from emitted tokens per verification step. F16 draft is official; Q8 draft is the existing local lossless-metadata quantization. Runtime outputs may differ because target arithmetic differs; no accuracy or speed-equivalence claim.
